blockers.B1: Gobra has no string indexing in the ghost language, and pure functions must be a single expression, so dom.ValidHandle / dom.ValidText cannot appear in a specification.
blockers.B2: Gobra does not thread a package-level var's initializer postcondition into method bodies; `assert ErrHandleTaken != nil` fails inside PutUser.
blockers.B3: Gobra does not re-instantiate an existentially-quantified postcondition at a call site; restating the store's clause verbatim one line after the call fails.
blockers.B4: vstd has no model of std::sync::RwLock or std::sync::Mutex (no std_specs/sync.rs), so a Verus spec fn cannot project MemStore's state.
blockers.B5: vstd::rwlock::RwLock exposes inv(&self, val) and ReadHandle::view() but no spec fn value(&self) -> V, so an abstraction function over lock-protected state is not definable even after swapping locks.
blockers.B6: Verus external_body proof twins are not mechanically linked to the production functions they mirror.
blockers.B7: Gobra cannot fold a concrete type's predicate through an interface-typed field, so clock.Clock reaches the service only via the untyped `nowLogical` / `tickLogical` trusted shims, which carry no postcondition.
